div.head: II Cn 18
div.ab: ⁊ hæbbe mann þriwa on geare burhgemot ⁊ tuwa scirgemot, butan hit oftor sig.
And habbe man ðriwa on geara burhgemot ⁊ twa scyrgemot, buton hit oftor sy.
Et habeatur in anno ter burgimotus et scyremotus bis, nisi sepius sit (necesse).
⁊ habbe man ðreowa burhgemot ⁊ twá scirgemot be wíte, ealswa hit riht is, buton hit oftor neod sy.
And hæbbe mann þriwa on geare burhgemot and tuwa scirgemot, butan hit oftor sig.
And the borough court shall be held three times and the shire court twice, in accordance with the law, under pain of fine, unless need arises for more frequent meetings.
And the borough court is to meet three times a year and the shire court twice unless the need arises more frequently.
Und dreimal im Jahre werde Stadtgericht und zweimal (zwei B A) Grafschaftsgericht gehalten, wenn es nicht öfter (nöthig B; Quadr. II; Inst.) ist.
And let the borough-court be held three times a year and the shire-court twice (two, B A), unless it is (needed, B; Quadr. II; Inst.) more often.
div.note: B's ‘be wite, ealswa hit riht is’ is probably wrongly repeated from 17.1. Liebermann compares III Eg 5.1.
scirgemot: B adds be wite ealswa hit riht is
oftor: B adds neod in a sixteeenth-century hand
